elements.name: street lamps as soft blurred lights
lit shop fronts as soft blurred lights

wrong_setting: The street reads as a generic Western or North American commercial strip: tall cobra-head lamp posts, American-style sedans and storefront signage. Nothing suggests Addis Ababa.
notes: Repaint edge to edge with no ragged paper corners, and remove the garbled shop-sign lettering. Make it darker night with heavier blur and visible reflections on the glass, and give the street Addis Ababa cues such as blue-and-white minibus taxis and local architecture.
